title: CLO 2024 Academic Month: Digital Virtual Design Assists in the Transformation and Upgrade of Fashion Design Education
description: Review of CLO Academic Month 2024! In a conversation with Professor Ji Yang, a key faculty member from the School of Clothing and Apparel Design at the University of Technology, he shared how to integrate digital garment technology into various aspects of the teaching system, such as auxiliary structure instruction, cultivating 3D design thinking, and simulating production processes. He also showcased outstanding graduation projects and award-winning competition entries during the discussion.

summary: # CLO 2024 Academic Month: Digital Virtual Design Assists in the Transformation and Upgrade of Fashion Design Education ## Introduction Good evening, students and teachers online. I am Ji Yang, a professional teacher in the field of clothing at Dalian University. Thank you very much for the forum organized by our Colour company. I am very happy to be able to share and communicate with you some of my experiences in teaching. This time, the topic is **Digital Virtual Design to Help Clothing Design Teaching Transformation and Upgrading**. It is mainly divided into three parts: 1. Introduction of our professional digitalization development process. 2. Application and results of digital virtual design in teaching. 3. Discussion on clothing design teaching transformation and upgrade. ## Background of Our School Our school was established in 1985 as a clothing school and is the first clothing major in the country. In 2013, it became the first comprehensive four-point major in the country and hosts a national experimental teaching demonstration center. - In 2014, I obtained my master's degree in teaching results. - In 2015, I received the virtual experimental teaching center in Liaoning Province. - In 2019, our school was recognized as the first-class construction major in the country. Currently, our school has four directions: - Clothing and clothing design - Clothing design and engineering - Performance - Digital media technology major, established in 2022. Our major, digitalized clothing design teaching, has been in development for nearly 20 years. Before 2009, digital teaching was gradually transformed from traditional teaching to multimedia teaching, utilizing digital images such as Photoshop and Kodak software for clothing design and teaching. ## Development of Digital Teaching Since 2009, our school introduced the clothing computer support design, which is the clothing system. This upgrade allowed for a significant enhancement in digital teaching. During this period, the software we cooperated with was AGM-S. My first exposure to virtual sewing technology occurred during my teaching, although at that time, it was still quite simple and basic. In 2012, our school introduced Cloud 3D software, which was more advanced than previous versions. Some professors and instructors had already begun researching the future of digitalization and virtualization in clothing design. Experiments were conducted on clothing engineering, virtual testing, fabric testing, and pressure testing. By 2016, several professors and students had completed the virtualization of their works, showcasing very technological and avant-garde results. Some professors began incorporating digital virtualization design into their scientific research projects, while others focused on traditional design, clothing restoration, and sports clothing. ## Virtual Design Integration in Curriculum In 2016, when the training project was set up, our school aimed to apply digitalized virtual technology to teaching. By 2018, the third-grade students began the virtual three-dimensional design class, while also employing this technology in educational reforms related to structural and engineering digitalization. At that time, the software for Clore had reached version 5.0, requiring high computer specifications that our existing computers could not support. As a result, our school invested significantly in building a digital virtual computer lab to meet our teaching and research requirements. In 2018, we prepared for the first batch of virtual anti-theft teaching experiments, a national first-class course. This virtual anti-theft teaching model became advantageous during the pandemic, promoting our digitalization efforts in educational reform. ## Outcomes of Digital Virtual Design in Education ### Industry Development Trends We recognize the importance of integrating virtual design technology into the fashion design profession. The primary reasons include: - The fashion industry promotes development and green initiatives. - Virtual design has the potential to enhance design efficiency and accuracy. - It strengthens practical control capabilities. - It cultivates comprehensive abilities in technology. - It fosters innovation in teaching methods, appealing to students' interests and engagement. ### Course Structure The course system is divided into four parts: 1. **Virtual Imitation Experiment**: Five classes where students engage with virtual imitation to enhance interaction and understanding of three-dimensional and two-dimensional clothing structures. 2. **Digital Technology Courses**: In the third grade, we focus on software for clothing and three-dimensional virtual design, allowing students to practice their assignments in a collaborative environment. 3. **Advanced Practical Courses**: These include design internships and comprehensive design experiences, facilitating the application of virtual design in real-world scenarios. 4. **Intelligent Suit Customization Project**: This project collaborates with Dalian Dayang Fashion Group, providing students with hands-on experience in a virtual factory setting. ## Innovations in Teaching Practices The integration of virtual design has led to the development of various innovative teaching practices. Students are encouraged to explore creative design through virtual methods, enhancing their practical skills and teamwork abilities. By utilizing software like Cloud 3D, students can design clothing structures digitally, allowing for iterative adjustments and improvements prior to physical production. ### Virtual Fashion Shows Our students have participated in numerous virtual fashion shows, showcasing their work despite challenges posed by the pandemic. The virtual format allows for a broader reach and more creative presentations, enabling students to experiment with different design concepts and technologies. ## Conclusion In conclusion, the transformation and upgrade of clothing design teaching through digital virtual design is a multifaceted process that enhances education quality, promotes innovative practices, and prepares students for the future of the fashion industry. Our school is committed to cultivating talents that can adapt to the evolving landscape of digital fashion design. Thank you all for your attention.
